events.context: ix commits 3487735→6648fa8 — ix-autoresearch crate Phases 1-7. Kernel + JSONL log + strategies + milestones; Target C grammar adapter; clap CLI + ix_autoresearch_run MCP tool; Targets A and B; end-to-end demo; live RebuildMode::CIReduced + validation harness; production-weights baseline. Phase 7 conclusion: weak signal — autoresearch produced statistically meaningful trend, not yet conclusive. Honest negative-result reporting validates the 'ship + measure' clause of autonomous-loop-policy.

ix introduced edit-eval-iterate framing (Karpathy-style) in commit 5a2ab4f. Distinct from PDCA in that the *evaluator* is itself part of the loop. Suggests an 'evaluator-in-the-loop' refinement of autonomous-loop-policy worth proposing as v1.2.0.

ix commit 652de21 — 'ix-quality-trend: nightly GA quality pipeline + structured health artifact'. Continuous quality measurement substrate. This is the missing dual of the harvest skill — Demerzel could port the pattern as 'governance-quality-trend' to track artifact effectiveness over time instead of one-shot compound runs.

ix commit ba79450 — 'ix-embedding-diagnostics: baseline leak-detection + cluster stability tool'. Detects when embeddings collapse or leak between train/eval. Translates directly to belief-state diagnostics for state/beliefs/ — could detect when governance beliefs are degenerate or contradictory in latent space.

effectiveness.proposition: autonomous-loop-policy is being validated by the largest concrete consumer to date (ix-autoresearch, 7 phases, MCP-exposed). Three new pattern candidates emerged: evaluator-in-the-loop, quality-trend substrate, embedding diagnostics for beliefs. Honest negative reporting on Phase 7 increases policy credibility.
